answer: Each identity must book one 30-minute bench at a city assay office, have a unique mineral pigment pellet sealed after a spectrometer reading, and lock 2,850 units for 24 days. The office publishes the reflectance curve; a reused cuvette, funding trail, or matching spectrum voids the certificate and burns the bond. An honest operator pays for one pellet and parks 2,850 units. Raising 130 sockpuppets needs 130 separate benches and 370,500 units left idle. If a farm's quality falls to a nadir of repeated breaches, the slash is posted and a refusal ripple follows any nearby curve.
